title: rust-mutants diagnostics v1
description: What one diagnostics bundle holds, and what the run it was gathered from did not leave. No environment variable's value is ever recorded.

run_id.description: The run the bundle is about.

run_directory.description: The directory it was gathered from.

held.description: The names in the bundle, in the order they were looked for.

absent.description: What the run did not leave, named so a reader knows it is not there rather than empty.
